mechanism.claim: A nonlinear regressor fitted before 2023 can separate positive from negative 72-hour BTC paths using causal price, derivatives, macro, and range-state features. Trading only prediction tails during high range volatility targets persistent volatile directional regimes.
mechanism.side: long in calibrated upper predicted-return tail; short in lower tail
mechanism.why_distinct: HVGBR uses one frozen histogram gradient-boosting regressor and a 72-hour continuous-return target. HVETCR used ExtraTrees class probabilities at 48 hours; HVMRR used an eight-hour raw microstructure block and linear six-hour ridge. No terminal model output, fitted artifact, threshold, control, or OOS result is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: range_vol must exceed a calibration-only 70th percentile before either side can trade

training_contract.anchors: every 72 completed 5m bars from fixed position 143
training_contract.label: continuous log(open at anchor+1+864/open at anchor+1)
training_contract.fit_rows: all anchors with complete label and finite entry/exit opens in fit window
training_contract.imputer: sklearn SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fit only on fit rows
training_contract.prediction_thresholds: strict empirical 15th and 85th percentiles of predicted 72-hour log return on calibration anchors only
training_contract.volatility_threshold: 70th percentile of range_vol on calibration anchors only

oos_clock.decisions: same fixed six-hour anchor schedule from 2023-07-01 onward
oos_clock.eligibility: all ordered features scoreable after fitted median imputation; range_vol >= frozen q70; predicted return <= frozen q15 or >= frozen q85
oos_clock.entry: anchor completed bar plus one 5m open
oos_clock.side: prediction>=q85 long; prediction<=q15 short; conflict impossible
oos_clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.historical_market: hash-bound 5m cache through 2026-06-01 plus bound funding/premium auxiliaries
source_plan.oos_execution_prices: sealed until source support and novelty pass

stopping_rule: freeze preregistration, fit/calibrate only before 2023-07, freeze model, then open OOS incidence, novelty, and sequential economics; terminal first failure
